name: imperial-os
description: IMPERIAL OS — shared backend with mobile execution and web administration

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @imperial/api & npm run dev -w @imperial/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @imperial/shared && npm run build -w @imperial/api && npm run build -w @imperial/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @imperial/shared && npm run build -w @imperial/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @imperial/shared && npm run db:generate -w @imperial/api && npm run build -w @imperial/api
